query:
SELECT state_name, district, district_label, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, rating, status
FROM house_races
WHERE state_name IN ('California', 'New York')
  AND status = 'General'
  AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL
  AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_name, district;
